text:
marta_marketing: Quick ask — launching 'Phoenix' next Tue. Need a tiny reproducible bench + smoke artifacts for the press kit and webinar. Can the runtime team run a focused sanity sweep today/tomorrow?

olivia_data: List of artifacts we need: raw latencies (p50,p90,p99), coldstart heatmap, quantized vs fp16 compare, sample inputs (100) + seed, exact model versions, warmup protocol, and the single command to reproduce. Marketing needs CSVs and a short README.

kevin_runtime: We can do that. Need exact model+seq lengths + traffic profile and preferred window. Also confirm whether quantized variant is the one on cluster-qa-quant.

marta_marketing: Model: redwood-vicuna-13b (export v2). Variant: quantized (int8) and fp16 for comparison. Typical seq: 512 (most requests). Tail: 2048 (5% of traffic). Traffic: steady 20 qps, bursts to 80. Cold-start to 1st-token matters for the PR.

sam_eng: FYI quantized variant is on cluster-qa-quant. We'll need to reserve for a 30–60m window for stability.

kevin_runtime: I can reserve 10:30–11:00 PT today. Plan: warmup 200 requests, then measured sweep of 1k requests matching your profile. Output: CSV (per-request), percentiles, flamegraphs (cpu/gpu), raw logs. Any sample payloads?

marta_marketing: Sample prompt set: one-shot summary, short creative prompt, and a multi-turn follow-up. Example payload: `{"prompt":"Summarize product update in two bullets","max_tokens":256,"temperature":0.2,"top_p":0.95}`. Use seed=42 for determinism across runs.

olivia_data: Please include token counts and per-token cost estimate per request. Also label warmup length, seed, and model tag in each filename. We'll need the coldstart timeline (time from request arrival to first token).

kevin_runtime: Got it. Also need sign-off to include anonymized traces and percentile plots in the press deck. No customer data will be included.

marta_marketing: Confirmed — anonymized traces ok, no customer content. Tag any fallback model ids if they occur.

sam_eng: Quick Q: for quantized vs fp16 — do you want separate runs or an interleaved A/B? Separate runs preferred to avoid cross-warmup contamination.

marta_marketing: Separate runs, same traffic profile and warmup. Label artifacts: phoenix_fp16_warmup200_seed42.csv and phoenix_quant_warmup200_seed42.csv style.

deploy-bot: Schedule created: runtime_job_8923 on cluster-qa-quant, start 1766667800, end 1766669400.

kevin_runtime: Starting warmup now. log: `warmup: 200 reqs ok`

kevin_runtime: Run complete. Summary: fp16 P50=78ms, P90=210ms, P99=640ms. quant P50=85ms, P90=230ms, P99=700ms. Coldstart-first-token: fp16 1.2s, quant 1.4s. Uploading artifacts: s3://redwood-inference/marketing/phoenix/1766667777/

olivia_data: Downloading artifacts. Quick glance — small tail spike around minute ~30 for quant. Can you re-run quantized with a longer warmup (1k) to check tail stability?

kevin_runtime: Scheduling extended warmup run now for 1766668360. Will warmup 1k and then replay the same 1k-measurement. Will diff the csvs and attach a short note on observed differences.

marta_marketing: Thanks. Please annotate filenames with warmup length and seed (e.g., phoenix_quant_warmup1000_seed42.csv) and add a short README describing traffic profile and the seed. Also include a one-line command to reproduce: `python replay.py --s3-path s3://... --seed 42 --warmup 1000`.

kevin_runtime: Done. New artifacts uploaded, README and replay script included. Paths and filenames show warmup/seed metadata. Also added per-token cost column to CSVs.

olivia_data: Perfect — marketing can draft the benchmark narrative and webinar slide with these artifacts. We'll follow up if we need tighter tail probing or demo cluster isolation.

sam_eng: :thumbsup: If you want a dedicated cluster for the live demo, ping us and we'll provision a short-lived pool.

marta_marketing: Appreciate it — this is great. We'll flag any follow-ups early.
